propositions: review_interrupts metric is published without reason dimension, making it impossible to distinguish bound-exceeded (bot busy, drain check working) from signal-unavailable (probe broken, deploys blind) in CloudWatch without host shell access

two distinct metrics with distinct alarm descriptions are needed so a CloudWatch-only sweep can route bound-exceeded and signal-unavailable firings to their different remediations without requiring journalctl access

observability.sh must emit review_interrupts_bound_exceeded and review_interrupts_signal_unavailable as separate dimensionless metrics while keeping the rolled-up review_interrupts total unchanged for historical readability

monitoring_autodeploy.tf must replace the single review_interrupts alarm with two reason-scoped alarms (one per metric), each keeping 900s/1-datapoint/Sum>0 cadence so signal-unavailable remains promptly alerting
the terraform apply (replacing old alarm, creating two new alarms) must be executed by an operator to take effect, as the code change alone does not update live infrastructure
